system.boundary: Build a closed-loop Simulink model of a three-axis lunar-module digital attitude autopilot driven by reaction-control jets.
engineering_objects: Couple the controller to three-axis rotational dynamics, discrete jet selection, bounded jet torque, and the available two-jet/four-jet and pitch/roll selection modes.
The applied RCS torque must change consistently with available thruster force.
jet_count_mode selects 2 or 4 available jets, pitch_roll_jet_mode selects mode 1 or 2, and thruster_force_scale scales nominal RCS authority.

interfaces.name: lunar_dap_case_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read lunar_dap_case_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate from 0 to 30 seconds. The lunar_dap_case_input struct has attitude_command_offset_deg as a finite real 3-by-1 vector in roll, pitch, yaw order with each component in [-15, 15] deg; initial_body_rate_deg_s as a finite real 3-by-1 vector in p, q, r order with each component in [-20, 20] deg/s; jet_count_mode as an integer scalar 2 or 4; pitch_roll_jet_mode as an integer scalar 1 or 2; and thruster_force_scale as a real scalar in [0.8, 1.2].

interfaces.name: attitude_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: attitude_state has width 6 in this order: roll_rad (rad), pitch_rad (rad), yaw_rad (rad), p_rad_s (rad/s), q_rad_s (rad/s), r_rad_s (rad/s).

interfaces.name: phase_plane_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: phase_plane_state has width 6 in this order: roll_command_offset_rad (rad), pitch_command_offset_rad (rad), yaw_command_offset_rad (rad), roll_tracking_error_rad (rad), pitch_tracking_error_rad (rad), yaw_tracking_error_rad (rad).

interfaces.name: rcs_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: rcs_state has width 6 in this order: yaw_jet_command (dimensionless), pitch_jet_command (dimensionless), roll_jet_command (dimensionless), jet_count_mode (dimensionless), pitch_roll_jet_mode (dimensionless), thruster_force_scale (dimensionless).
